situation.person: New mother receiving traditional postpartum help (omugwo) from her mother or mother-in-law who loves the baby fiercely but runs the household and baby-care by her own pre-1990s rules
situation.specific_situation: The helper arrives with strong practices - substances on the cord, herb water for baby, baby handed over at all hours, visitors flooding in - while hospital instructions said otherwise and the mother is too exhausted and polite to push back
situation.timeframe: Weeks 0-6 postpartum, concentrated in the helper's first 10 days on site
situation.problem: She cannot tell which traditions are harmless gold versus documented infection/danger risks, cannot refuse without triggering family war, and is sliding from mother to furniture in her own home
situation.failed_attempt: Tried hinting and silent resistance; helper doubled down or got hurt; partner stayed neutral to keep peace
constraints: Cultural weight of 'how we did it'
situation.emotional_stake: She fears harming the baby by obeying AND destroying the family fabric by refusing - and quietly mourns becoming a guest in her own maternity
situation.desired_transformation: A written three-zone agreement (hers/together/doctor-backed) that gives grandma proud ownership of real work, protects medical non-negotiables as the DOCTOR'S rules not hers, and preserves both the tradition and the mother

new_capabilities: Runs the Agreement conversation before Day 1
Routes every clash through Zone C paper, not personal argument
improvements: Grandma proudly owns Zone A work
Zero substances reach baby after agreement
remaining_limits: Not a treatment for clinical mood disorders
evidence_of_change: Clashes drop to near-zero after paper rule installed
Mother reports protected sleep achieved most nights
Helper publicly defends the rules to visitors

mechanism.core_mechanism: Authority transfer + energy redirection: medical rules attributed to the clinician (paper absorbs shame), grandmother given proud ownership of high-value Zone A work, scripts honour-then-rule-then-role
mechanisms: Proud ownership converts enforcer into ally
mechanism.why_it_should_work: Conflict here is about status and love-language, not hygiene knowledge; systems that preserve status while changing defaults succeed where explanations failed

evidence_basis.claim: Omugwo-style support associates with reduced postpartum depression and better maternal rest
evidence_basis.source: Punch Nigeria report on omugwo & PPD; NCBI reviews of African postpartum confinement

evidence_basis.claim: Nothing-on-cord / milk-only / safe-sleep rules are WHO/AAP-derived standards
evidence_basis.source: WHO postnatal recommendations 2014/2022; AAP cord care statement 2016

evidence_basis.claim: Documented harmful traditional cord substances include toothpaste/herbs/hot compresses
evidence_basis.source: Onubogu et al. AJPR 2022 (Nnewi); Ghana qualitative study PMC11667800

transformation_path.objective: Draft the Agreement; claim your blocks; brief partner on Script 6 role
Ten-minute Agreement talk; post House Card
Redirect clashes to paper; protect blocks; weekly tea review
Any boil moment routes to Rescue Card moves, never explosion

failure_point_map.rescue_protocol: Rinse/photo/decision criteria; clinic call framed as question; Script 3 reset privately same day
Reduce helper exposure 48h honorably ('rest'); escalate to family elder ally if exists; protect blocks solo via schedule shift
Shorten visit window honorably + tell one person honestly; mood lines if darkening
Zone A promotion speech: name what she owns; assign the teaching role to restore status
Remote-village skeleton: nightly video direction + one delegated local task; name the grief aloud once

first_win.action: Fill the Agreement Kit's Zone C card and send it (photo/message) to the incoming helper framed as 'the paediatrician's list for THIS baby'
first_win.observable_change: Rules exist on paper before she lands - the first clash gets answered by the card, not an improvisation

before_baseline: clashes per day over baby care
tsm.success_threshold: 60%+ completers meet >=3 of 4 indicators at Day-14 review
tsm.measurement_method: Daily tally + structured week-1 tea review notes
tsm.incomplete_progress_interpretation: Friction spikes on visitor days and weekends are expected; repeated Zone-C breaches trigger the partner-channel escalation rather than reset
tsm.next_action_on_miss: Re-run Agreement talk using Rescue Card move 1-2 sequence; shorten visit window honorably if needed

maintenance.maintenance_system: Weekly tea review while helper stays; monthly partner sync on household zones
maintenance.relapse_protocol: New visitor/helper arrives → hand them the fridge card first, scripts second
maintenance.reentry_protocol: After any blowup, restart at Week-1 review with tea, no tribunal

evidence.source: Punch Nigeria; NCBI African confinement reviews

safety.scope_boundary: Coordinates household roles and communication ONLY. Never adjudicates clinical questions (routes to clinician), never treats mood disorders (routes via crisis lines), never overrides baby's doctor.
red_flags: any substance reached cord stump or baby's mouth
mother's mood darkening past two weeks or thoughts of harm
escalation_rules: Clinical incidents -> decision criteria + clinic line
Mood crisis -> verified shared crisis list numbers immediately

research_disposition.rationale: Flagship #4 (score 83). Distinct situation (un-negotiated traditional help) + distinct transformation (three-zone terms system). Cultural wedge with globally relatable core (managing loving overreach).

evidence_refs: Punch Nigeria; NCBI African confinement reviews
